quick_skim.title: A Splitting Method for SDE Terminal-Law Estimation
quick_skim.abstract: In many settings involving stochastic differential equations, including in diffusion based generative AI, our aim is to accurately generate samples from a terminal distribution. Typically, this is done by generating i.i.d. samples of diffusion paths. Given a fixed simulation budget, a reasonable way to gain efficiency may be to instead generate a tree of paths through appropriately split partial paths. This suggests improved performance, but one worries about the injected dependence. In this paper, we study this issue comprehensively. With Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance as a measure of accuracy, we identify the limiting errors of the associated empirical distributions as the simulation budget increases to infinity. We characterize a splitting strategy motivated by a corresponding asymptotic optimization problem. The theoretical results bring out the elegant underlying structure in the problem. Practical implementation involves two phases, an initial estimation phase and a final inference phase. Overall, we observe a 10-25% improvement in mean error over i.i.d. samples in many settings. In an exploratory CIFAR-10 study, our method reduces the maximum mean discrepancy by 8-13%.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: A splitting method is proposed for SDE terminal-law estimation in diffusion generative AI: instead of i.i.d. path sampling, trees of split partial paths are generated, with limiting errors characterized via Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance and a principled splitting strategy derived.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 扩散生成模型常需从随机微分方程的终端分布中采样，传统做法在固定模拟预算下生成独立同分布路径，效率有限。本文提出对部分路径进行分裂以形成路径树，从而在相同预算下获得更高精度，并以Kolmogorov-Smirnov距离刻画经验分布的极限误差，分析了分裂引入的相关性影响。研究给出了一种有理论依据的分裂策略，为免训练的扩散采样效率优化提供了新思路。
